subject: System Design
title: Elasticsearch and Full-Text Search
description: A fast breakdown of Elasticsearch and Full-Text Search for builders.

hook.text: You search for 'running shoes' and results include 'jogging sneakers.' The search understands meaning, not just words.

buildup.text: Elasticsearch uses inverted indices with analyzers that tokenize, stem, and normalize text for matching.

discovery.text: Stemming reduces 'running' to 'run.' Synonyms map 'shoes' to 'sneakers.' The index matches concepts, not exact strings.

twist.text: Elasticsearch clusters can grow to petabytes but require careful shard management. Too many shards degrade performance.

climax.text: Elasticsearch powers search at GitHub, Wikipedia, and Stack Overflow — anywhere full-text search at scale is needed.

punchline.text: Tokenize, stem, and index — search meaning, not exact words.

quiz.question: What does stemming do in search?
options: Reduces words to their root form so 'running' matches 'run'
